intent: Allows a user to reset their forgotten password and regain access to their account.
preconditions: User is on the login page.
postconditions: All Login Sessions for the Account are invalidated
User can log in with the new Password.

steps.precondition: User is on the login page.
steps.postcondition: System has received a request for a password reset link with an email address.
steps.description: The User requests a Password Reset Link from the System.
steps.sourceText: 1. FR1: A user on the login page can click "Forgot password" to enter their registered email address and request a reset link.

steps.precondition: System has received a request for a password reset link with an email address; The provided email address matches a registered Account.
steps.postcondition: Password Reset Link sent to User's email; Password Reset Link is valid for 30 minutes.
steps.description: The System sends a Password Reset Link to the User's email address.
steps.sourceText: 2. FR2: If the email matches a registered account, the system sends a reset link to that email; the link is valid for 30 minutes from send time. If the email does not match any account, the system shows the same generic confirmation message (no account-enumeration signal).

steps.precondition: User has received a valid, unexpired Password Reset Link.
steps.postcondition: User is on the new password entry form.
steps.description: The User clicks the received Password Reset Link, which directs them to the System.
steps.sourceText: 3. FR3: Clicking a valid, unexpired reset link takes the user to a form to enter and confirm a new password.

steps.precondition: User is on the new password entry form; The new Password meets complexity rules.
steps.postcondition: System has received a new Password that meets complexity rules.
steps.description: The User enters and confirms a new password for their Account to the System.
steps.sourceText: 4. FR4: A new password must be at least 12 characters and contain at least one letter and one number. If it does not meet these rules, the system rejects it and shows the specific unmet rule(s).

steps.businessObject: Password Reset Link, Login Session, Account
steps.precondition: System has received a new Password that meets complexity rules.
steps.postcondition: Password Reset Link is invalidated; All Login Sessions for the Account are invalidated; Confirmation message displayed to User; User can log in with the new Password.
steps.description: The System invalidates the Password Reset Link and all active Login Sessions for the Account, then displays a confirmation message to the User.
steps.sourceText: 5. FR5: On successful password change, the system invalidates the reset link, invalidates all existing login sessions for that account, and displays a confirmation that the user can now log in with the new password.

alternativeFlows.triggerCondition: The provided email address does not match any registered Account.

steps.precondition: System has received a request for a password reset link with an email address; The provided email address does not match any registered Account.
steps.postcondition: Generic confirmation message displayed to User.
steps.description: The System displays a generic confirmation message to the User, without confirming if the email exists.
steps.sourceText: 2. FR2: If the email matches a registered account, the system sends a reset link to that email; the link is valid for 30 minutes from send time. If the email does not match any account, the system shows the same generic confirmation message (no account-enumeration signal).

alternativeFlows.triggerCondition: The new Password does not meet complexity rules.

steps.precondition: User is on the new password entry form; The new Password does not meet complexity rules.
steps.postcondition: System displays specific unmet password rules to User.
steps.description: The System rejects the new password and displays specific unmet password rules to the User.
steps.sourceText: 4. FR4: A new password must be at least 12 characters and contain at least one letter and one number. If it does not meet these rules, the system rejects it and shows the specific unmet rule(s).

exceptionFlows.triggerCondition: The Password Reset Link is expired or already used.

steps.precondition: User clicks a Password Reset Link; Password Reset Link is expired or already used.
steps.postcondition: Error message displayed to User; System offers to send a new Password Reset Link.
steps.description: The System displays an error message to the User, indicating the link is invalid, and offers to send a new Password Reset Link.
steps.sourceText: 6. FR6: If a reset link is expired or already used, the system shows an error and offers to send a new one (returning to FR1's flow).
